lab.quote: Given these uncertainties, we are not providing any formal guidance at this stage and will instead assess the situation quarter by quarter and month by month.

call_memory.quote: Given these uncertainties, we are not providing any formal guidance at this stage and will instead assess the situation quarter by quarter and month by month.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management is not providing any formal guidance for FY27 given environment uncertainties around war inflation and El Niño.

lab.quote: We expect to ship tractors to the US by the end of this year, with the market launch planned by the end of calendar year 2027.

call_memory.quote: We expect to ship tractors to the US by the end of this year, with the market launch planned by the end of calendar year 2027.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Shipments of tractors to the US are expected by the end of this year, with market launch planned by the end of calendar year 2027.

lab.quote: Additionally, we have already announced the launch of electric tillers and weeders, with commercialization expected to scale up from Q2 onwards.

call_memory.quote: Additionally, we have already announced the launch of electric tillers and weeders, with commercialization expected to scale up from Q2 onwards.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Commercialization of electric tillers and weeders is expected to scale up from Q2 onwards.

lab.quote: what we are focused on is adjacencies or within the same domain we are looking at both global as well as in India, we are evaluating multiple opportunities and hopefully in the next 6 months or so we should be able to close down on at least one of them.

call_memory.quote: what we are focused on is adjacencies or within the same domain we are looking at both global as well as in India, we are evaluating multiple opportunities and hopefully in the next 6 months or so we should be able to close down on at least one of them.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Company is evaluating inorganic opportunities in adjacencies or within its domain and expects to close at least one acquisition in the next 6 months.

lab.quote: Investments are at about close to 600 crores.

call_memory.quote: Investments are at about close to 600 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Cash on balance sheet investments are close to Rs 600 crore.

lab.quote: In the last 3 years we have grown from roughly about 2,000 numbers to last year close to 11,500.

call_memory.quote: In the last 3 years we have grown from roughly about 2,000 numbers to last year close to 11,500.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Power weeder volume grew from roughly about 2,000 units to close to 11,500 units last year in the last 3 years.

call_memory.condition: unless new schemes are announced by state governments

lab.quote: I believe the industry volume is likely to remain around the 10–11 lakh range. Therefore, the market is expected to remain broadly flat this year unless new schemes are announced by state governments.

call_memory.quote: I believe the industry volume is likely to remain around the 10–11 lakh range. Therefore, the market is expected to remain broadly flat this year unless new schemes are announced by state governments.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Overall tractor industry volume is likely to remain around the 10-11 lakh range and broadly flat this year.

lab.quote: In the power tiller segment, we hold a market share of around 70%–75%, and Chinese imports are not permitted in this segment.

call_memory.quote: In the power tiller segment, we hold a market share of around 70%–75%, and Chinese imports are not permitted in this segment.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Company holds a market share of around 70% to 75% in the power tiller segment where Chinese imports are not permitted.

lab.quote: In the power weeder segment, however, our market share is currently only around 6%–7%.

call_memory.quote: In the power weeder segment, however, our market share is currently only around 6%–7%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Power weeder market share is currently around 6% to 7%, dominated by Chinese imports.

lab.quote: In this segment, we command a market share of over 10% in these states.

call_memory.quote: In this segment, we command a market share of over 10% in these states.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Company commands a market share of over 10% in the four-wheel-drive compact tractor segment in Maharashtra and Gujarat, but overall tractor industry market share is less than 1%.

lab.quote: Over the last two years, around 10% of our power tiller business has been supported through retail financing. We expect this share to increase to nearly 20% this year and continue growing further, similar to the trend seen in the tractor industry.

call_memory.quote: Over the last two years, around 10% of our power tiller business has been supported through retail financing. We expect this share to increase to nearly 20% this year and continue growing further, similar to the trend seen in the tractor industry.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Retail financing supported around 10% of power tiller business over the last two years and is expected to increase to nearly 20% this year.

lab.quote: Power tiller is typically at around two lakhs, and the power weeder is roughly at about 60,000.

call_memory.quote: Power tiller is typically at around two lakhs, and the power weeder is roughly at about 60,000.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Average price for a power tiller is typically around Rs 2 lakh and power weeder is roughly around Rs 60,000.

lab.quote: Earlier, delivery cycles used to take around 30 to 45 days, whereas now they take nearly 90 to 120 days because shipments have to take longer routes.

call_memory.quote: Earlier, delivery cycles used to take around 30 to 45 days, whereas now they take nearly 90 to 120 days because shipments have to take longer routes.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: European delivery transit times increased from 30-45 days to nearly 90 to 120 days due to the ongoing war situation forcing longer shipping routes.

lab.quote: On the R&D front, we have been investing approximately ₹50–60 crore annually in product development over the last four to five years. In addition to this, we have announced a further investment of over ₹100 crore towards the development of our global tech centre.

call_memory.quote: On the R&D front, we have been investing approximately ₹50–60 crore annually in product development over the last four to five years. In addition to this, we have announced a further investment of over ₹100 crore towards the development of our global tech centre.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Annual product development spend continues in the Rs 50 to 60 crore range alongside a separate investment of over Rs 100 crore for the global tech centre.

lab.quote: Overall, we expect around 16–20 product launches over the next 18 months.

call_memory.quote: Overall, we expect around 16–20 product launches over the next 18 months.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Company plans to launch 16 to 20 products over the next 18 months, comprising three compact tractor platforms translating to 12-16 variants, two higher HP upgrades, and one new platform.

lab.quote: However, for tractors above 50 HP, the implementation of technologies such as DOC, DPF, and CRDI significantly increases costs, with the impact varying between 20% and 30% depending on the manufacturer. This has already affected the market, and we have seen volumes decline in the above-50 HP segment after the introduction of the new emission norms.

call_memory.quote: However, for tractors above 50 HP, the implementation of technologies such as DOC, DPF, and CRDI significantly increases costs, with the impact varying between 20% and 30% depending on the manufacturer. This has already affected the market, and we have seen volumes decline in the above-50 HP segment after the introduction of the new emission norms.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: TREM V emission norms increase costs by 20% to 30% for tractors above 50 HP due to DOC, DPF, and CRDI systems, causing industry demand to shift toward the 40-50 HP category.

lab.quote: So we are positive that we will be able to operate between 12% to 14%.

call_memory.quote: So we are positive that we will be able to operate between 12% to 14%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Operational EBITDA margin is expected to operate between 12% to 14%.

lab.quote: See by FY30 in the last call also I have said in FY30 we will reach about 5,000 to 6,000 tractors on the higher speed trend.

call_memory.quote: See by FY30 in the last call also I have said in FY30 we will reach about 5,000 to 6,000 tractors on the higher speed trend.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Looking to reach about 5,000 to 6,000 tractors in the higher HP segment by FY30.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Planning to do an all-India wide launch of electric weeders and electric tillers in early Q2 of this year.

lab.quote: So by the end of 2027 we will be launching the products in the market.

call_memory.quote: So by the end of 2027 we will be launching the products in the market.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Launching products in the US market by the end of 2027 with trials starting this year onwards.

lab.quote: We are also doing a Netherlands based operation in Europe, which we said that we will be launching in June, July of this year which is going as per plan.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT

lab.quote: We are at about 36 days of inventory.

call_memory.quote: We are at about 36 days of inventory.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Maintained inventory levels at about 36 days.

lab.quote: In FY25 we had taken receivables to about 75 days. We have brought it down this year to 51 days and we believe there's some more room for improvement there in those operations.

call_memory.quote: In FY25 we had taken receivables to about 75 days. We have brought it down this year to 51 days and we believe there's some more room for improvement there in those operations.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Receivables days brought down to 51 days this year from 75 days in FY25.

lab.quote: We have taken a price increase towards end of April. We are watching this closely. If this continues to grow or inflation continues to sustain, it will be difficult to pass on the entire inflation to the consumer.

call_memory.quote: We have taken a price increase towards end of April. We are watching this closely. If this continues to grow or inflation continues to sustain, it will be difficult to pass on the entire inflation to the consumer.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Passed on a bit of the commodity and fuel cost inflation to consumers through a price increase taken towards the end of April across power tillers and tractors.

lab.quote: If you look at full year, last year there was a gain of INR24 crores. Against that there's a loss of INR6 crores in the current year.

call_memory.quote: If you look at full year, last year there was a gain of INR24 crores. Against that there's a loss of INR6 crores in the current year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Recorded a fair value loss from investments of Rs 6 crore for the full year against a gain of Rs 24 crore last year.

lab.quote: One is the inflation that is hitting us, both through fuel price rise as well as commodity price rise.

call_memory.quote: One is the inflation that is hitting us, both through fuel price rise as well as commodity price rise.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Cost inflation hitting management through fuel price rises as well as commodity price rises.

lab.quote: The prediction is for 92% LPA kind of monsoon and over the long period average it will be at 92%.

call_memory.quote: The prediction is for 92% LPA kind of monsoon and over the long period average it will be at 92%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Monsoon prediction is for 92% LPA long period average rainfall.

lab.quote: As far as the investment is concerned, we have provisioned for those investments already.

call_memory.quote: As far as the investment is concerned, we have provisioned for those investments already.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT

call_points.text: Strategic pathway includes maximizing capacity utilization for higher horsepower tractor implements.
Management refrained from giving formal FY27 guidance due to monsoon and inflation uncertainties, assessing month by month.
Overall tractor industry volume is expected to remain broadly flat in the 10-11 lakh range unless state schemes are announced.
Cash and investment balance stands at close to ₹600 crore.
Retail finance share in power tillers reached 10% over last two years and is targeted to increase to nearly 20% this year.
Extended delivery transit times to Europe (90-120 days vs 30-45 days earlier) due to war situation constrained inventory rotation.
Management aims for growth in Q1FY27 but takes a quarter-by-quarter view for FY27 due to macro uncertainties.
Management expects EBITDA margins to operate in the range of 12% to 14%.
VST Zetor tractor sales aimed at 5,000 to 6,000 units annually by FY30.
Electric tillers and weeders scheduled for an all-India launch in early Q2 of this year.
Implemented price increases across power tillers and tractors in late April to offset rising input costs.
Monsoon spatial distribution and commodity inflation pose operational risks for FY27.
Domestic tractor sales rose 18.6% YoY to 4,596 units in FY26.
Power reaper volume expanded 44.2% YoY to 3,464 units in FY26.

operating_notes.text: FY26 power tiller sales reached 50,332 units (up 34.9% YoY).
FY26 domestic tractor sales reached 4,596 units (up 18.6% YoY); export tractor sales were 1,316 units (down 6.7% YoY).
FY26 power weeder sales reached 11,346 units (up 52.1% YoY).
Generated operating cash flows of ₹132 Cr in FY26 vs ₹76 Cr in FY25.
Inventory levels held at 36 days as of FY26.
Receivables cycle reduced to 51 days in FY26 from 75 days in FY25.
Retail financing reached 10% of total sales in FY26.

Global tech centre construction commencing soon, targeted to become operational by 2027 with ~₹100 Cr infrastructure investment.
Ships tractors to US by end of 2026, targeting commercial market launch by end of CY27.
FieldTrac brand tractor sales driving organic presence in 40+ international countries including EU.
